name: Stoneshape
description:
You touch a stone object or section of a stone object no more than 5 feet in any dimension. Choose one:

  • You form the stone into any shape you choose. The form may be functional - like a simple door or a bridge - but fine mechanical or artistic detail isn’t possible. The change is permanent.

  • You cause the stone to crumble into small chunks.

Check a Condition.

Describe how you shape the stone.

improvements.name: Greater Stoneshape
improvements.description: You may instead target a stone object or section of a stone object no more than 10 feet in any dimension that is within short range.

improvements.name: Superior Stoneshape
improvements.description: You may instead target a stone object or section of a stone object no more than 20 feet in any dimension that is within medium range.
